title: "The Beatles never played Brazil"

The Beatles played about 1,400 shows between 1957 and 1966. Not one of them was in South America.

They played 20 countries and territories, from Hamburg to Manila to Wellington. Brazil, Argentina, Chile: zero.

The first Beatle to play Brazil arrived in April 1990, 24 years after the band's last tour. Paul McCartney did two nights at the Maracanã, and one of them drew 184,000 paying fans, at the time the largest paying stadium crowd on record.

Then the market went quiet again. Two shows in 1993, then nothing for 17 years.

Since 2010, Paul has come back in 9 of 17 years. I count 39 shows in Brazil in total, 35 of them since 2010, nine in 2023 alone. I was in the crowd at 10 of them.

Brazil went from a country the Beatles never reached to one of the most regular stops of the man who co-wrote most of their songs.

The demand did not disappear between 1966 and 1990. It sat there unserved, and the first night of supply showed how big the queue had become.

Unmet demand does not vanish. It waits for someone to supply it.

Which artist is your country still waiting for?
